propositions: Define immutable provider-neutral operation and outcome enums with canonical JSON serialization: Disposition, FailureScope, ReplaySafety, DelaySource; invocation and request counts; logical_id retained across all physical invocations.

Enforce retry budget limits of exactly three physical invocations and 15,000 ms cumulative sleep with fake-clock scheduling using additive jitter: index 0 selects [2s,3s), index 1 selects [4s,5s), no third sleep permitted.

Implement bounded diagnostic storage capped at eight entries with redaction via sanitize_diagnostic seam; messages truncated to 512 Unicode code points; ninth-plus inputs trigger truncation sentinel with dropped count.

Handle ambiguous writes via observe-before-replay: desired state yields recovered; conclusive old state replays within budget; failed or inconclusive observation yields non-replaying commit_unknown with ReplaySafety.forbidden.
Provider-authoritative delays act as sleep lower bounds never shortened; delays exceeding remaining budget return retry_not_before without executing hidden work or incrementing counters.

Canonical serialization via rebar._store.canonical.canonical_bytes produces byte-identical compact UTF-8 JSON for equivalent outcomes; all enums serialize as lowercase strings with durations in milliseconds and retry_not_before in UTC RFC 3339 with Z.
